name: hf_2026_07
note: Replay of the July 2026 OpenAI/Hugging Face incident. PUBLISHED and used as-is: the nine phase names, action counts, and start/end times (Hugging Face technical timeline), and which kinds of action each phase contained (from the command examples in that timeline). NOT PUBLISHED, so randomized on every run rather than guessed: the share of each kind within a phase (drawn uniformly over the allowed kinds) and the bytes per network action (drawn log-uniformly between net_bytes_range). Reported catch rates are over many such draws. The 16,521 phase actions differ from the ~17,600 total in the post because phases overlap and the post rounds. One secondary summary says the intrusion lasted 13 hours; the Hugging Face timeline says about 4.5 days, and that primary source is used.
